title: RNA 3′ ends / termination
description: Study-curated dominant RNA 3′ ends in the first 500 kb, with real gene labels, replicate counts and source termination-mechanism labels where classified.
processing: Read TableS1 of the source supplementary workbook, keeping all curated dominant end positions below 500000. Preserve source gene, strand, source integer-truncated mean count, upstream/downstream DNA sequences, predicted RNAfold structure and its stability. Join raw GEO per-position replicate counts by exact coordinate and the opposite count-table strand: the gene/RNA strand in TableS1 is opposite the GEO mapped-count strand. This relation was checked across all 1098 TableS1 records: the integer-truncated mean of opposite-strand counts equals the supplied source mean for every record. Join TableS2 by locus tag and exact position for source termination-mechanism/Rho-dependence classification; unclassified rows are explicitly labeled. No mechanism is inferred here.
coordinateSystem: Genomic positions preserved exactly from the source tables on CP009273; coordinate-origin convention not independently established
limits: A 500 kb subset of TableS1, not the complete 1098-end map.
TableS2 classifies only a subset; unclassified records remain unclassified.

The source mean read counts are truncated to integers; exact replicate counts and an unrounded mean are also retained. Gene strand is opposite the GEO mapped-count strand, which is retained separately.
Predicted RNAfold stability is computational, not a measured folding energy.
Source coordinate-origin convention has not been independently verified; positions are preserved exactly, not converted.
